request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  400
error[ZC-E0807]: a name on the removed list was refused a certificate
  cause  node node3 is on the server's list of removed names (revoked)
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    remove its name from the revoked file; the server rereads it within a second
  more   zcube explain E0807
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0807.html
